title: Convey the complaint so it can be answered
title_ar: انقل الشكوى بشكل يمكن الرد عليه

scenario.en: A relative is upset with a delivery company and wants you to write for them in English.
scenario.ar: حد من عيلتك متضايق من شركة توصيل وعايزك تكتب بالإنجليزي بدالهم.

source: What they told you: the parcel was due on the ninth and arrived on the nineteenth. They took a day off work to receive it. They say the service is irritating and unprofessional. They would accept a refund of the delivery fee.

task.en: Convey the complaint in a form the company can act on, and explain the significance.
task.ar: انقل الشكوى بشكل الشركة تقدر تتصرف فيه، واشرح الأهمية.

key_points.en: State the event: due on the ninth, arrived on the nineteenth.
State the effect: a day off work was taken.
State the remedy: a refund of the delivery fee.
Leave out the judgements the company cannot act on.
key_points.ar: سيب الأحكام اللي الشركة مش قادرة تتصرف فيها.

model_answer.en: Let me be precise: a parcel due on the ninth arrived on the nineteenth, and the recipient took a day off work to receive it. A refund of the delivery fee would settle the matter. I have left out the judgements the company cannot act on — the significance is that this version can be answered, whereas calling the service irritating cannot.
model_answer.ar: خليني أكون دقيق: شحنة كانت مستحقة ٩ ووصلت ١٩، والمستلم أخد يوم أجازة عشان يستلمها. واسترداد مصاريف التوصيل يحل الموضوع. وسيبت الأحكام اللي الشركة مش قادرة تتصرف فيها — والأهمية إن الصيغة دي يمكن الرد عليها، لكن إننا نقول إن الخدمة مزعجة لأ.
